scripts.verify: npm run verify:ios && npm run verify:android && npm run verify:web && npm run verify:electron
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.test:p0: npm run test:p0:js && npm run test:p0:ios && npm run test:p0:android
scripts.test:p0:js: tsc --target es2017 --module commonjs --outDir build/test-p0 src/sql.ts && node --test test/sql-guard.test.cjs
scripts.test:p1: npm run test:p0 && npm run verify:web && npm run verify:electron
scripts.test:p2: npm run test:p1 && npm run test:p2:js
scripts.test:p2:js: tsc --target es2017 --module commonjs --outDir build/test-p2 src/migrations.ts && node --test test/migration-validation.test.cjs
scripts.test:suite:android:build: cd playground && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test:suite:android: npm run test:suite:android:build && npm run test:suite:android:deploy && node test/suite/run-android-cdp.mjs
scripts.test:suite:android:stress: npm run test:suite:android:build && npm run test:suite:android:deploy && node test/suite/run-android-cdp.mjs --stress
scripts.test:suite:ios:build: cd playground && npm run build && npx cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "${IOS_DESTINATION:-platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro}" -derivedDataPath ../../../build/test-suite-ios build
scripts.test:suite:ios:deploy: xcrun simctl terminate booted com.devioarts.example.sqlite; xcrun simctl uninstall booted com.devioarts.example.sqlite; xcrun simctl install booted build/test-suite-ios/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/App.app && xcrun simctl launch booted com.devioarts.example.sqlite
scripts.test:suite:ios: npm run test:suite:ios:build && npm run test:suite:ios:deploy && node test/suite/run-ios-cdp.mjs
scripts.test:suite:ios:stress: npm run test:suite:ios:build && npm run test:suite:ios:deploy && node test/suite/run-ios-cdp.mjs --stress
scripts.lint: npm run eslint && npm run prettier -- --check && npm run swiftlint -- lint Package.swift ios/Sources ios/Tests
scripts.fmt: npm run eslint -- --fix && npm run prettier -- --write && npm run swiftlint -- --fix --format Package.swift ios/Sources ios/Tests
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run docgen && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs && npm run build:electron
